charts.title: K2-199 b: orbits around K2-199
charts.description: The orbits of K2-199's planets in this map from above, to scale, with K2-199 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Akana Murphy et al. 2021 (2021AJ....162..294A), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname AKANA_MURPHY_ET_AL__2021): P 3.2253993 d

charts.title: K2-199 b: its transit
charts.description: K2-199 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 1 sector (91) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 2621212, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 4 minutes earlier to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 12 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 8-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 4 min early; 8-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 4 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
